scope: Fast generated ASCII/Binary DXF reader coverage for applyExtrusion across all standard DIMENSION subtype values 0 through 6; existing production conversion code is unchanged

authority.title: Autodesk Common Dimension Group Codes (DXF)
rules: Dimension subtype values 0 through 6 identify rotated/linear, aligned, angular, diameter, radius, angular-3-point, and ordinate dimensions; bit 32 is set in R13 and later records.
Groups 10, 13, 14, and 15 are WCS points; groups 11, 12, and 16 are OCS points.

authority.title: Autodesk Object Coordinate Systems (DXF)
authority.rule: The OCS basis is calculated from the extrusion direction using the arbitrary-axis algorithm.

behaviorCovered: Generated R2013 DXF records use group-70 subtype values with the documented bit-32 flag.
The reader dispatches typed callbacks for all seven subtype values in ASCII and Binary DXF.
For every subtype, group-10 WCS definition and the tested subtype-specific group-13/14/15 WCS points remain unchanged in both extrusion modes.
For every subtype, group-11 OCS text point remains OCS by default and maps to WCS under applyExtrusion using an arbitrary X-axis normal.
The existing focused control continues to verify group-12 clone conversion for linear dimensions and group-16 arc-point conversion for two-line angular dimensions.

control.fixtureDisposition: Inputs are generated in a temporary directory and deleted; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

limitations: Generated parser/callback coordinate evidence only; no physical-producer pair or native CAD consumer was used.
No dimension text rendering, orientation, measurement, or associative semantic qualification follows.
ARC_DIMENSION and LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION are separate nonstandard/custom carriers and are not included.
